async () => { if (!window.rooms['break_room']) await window.loadRoom('break_room'); const r = window.rooms['break_room']; if (!r) return 'not-loaded'; for (const id of 'david_torres'.split(',').filter(Boolean)) { const n = window.npcManager && window.npcManager.npcs.get(id); if (n && n._sprite) n._sprite.setVisible(true); } const cam = (window.lightingSystem?.scene || window.game).cameras.main; cam.stopFollow(); cam.centerOn(r.position.x + r.map.widthInPixels / 2, r.position.y + r.map.heightInPixels / 2); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 400)); const s = window.lightingSystem?.rooms.get('break_room'); return s ? (s.on ? 'on' : 'off') : 'no-lighting'; }
